entities.name: Prussian Education System
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The first modern compulsory public education system, established by Prussia in the early 19th century under Wilhelm von Humboldt. Featuring age-graded classrooms, trained professional teachers, standardized curricula, and state funding, the Prussian model was adopted by virtually every nation and remains the template for public education worldwide.
